description: "Farmacias Similunares" is a multidisciplinary team of undergraduate students committed to putting our best efforts into developing an innovative health monitoring system for a future lunar base. Our goal is to help astronauts face the extreme challenges of extraterrestrial healthcare. By combining our diverse backgrounds and perspectives, we aim to make medical assistance accessible, efficient, and reliable even beyond Earth.
summary:
System for Interplanetary Monitoring & Integration (S.I.M.I.) is an implemented software designed by Farmacias Similunares as a measurement to tackle Challenge #5 as a web platform programmed to measure 35 health statistics which include vital signs, sleep, radiation, ambient, psychoemotional and psychomotor state of the astronaut, which will then be contrasted and classified into defined parameters based on NASA-STD-3001 and NASA Twins Study, with the objective of warning possible health risks and suggesting actions that can prevent said risks. The way it works is through identification of the crew member, a 2-minute block of tests, and a report generated based on said results and the other 28 tracked metrics we integrate into a comprehensible and practical report. Finally, Dr.S.I.M.I. bot offers real-time diagnosis and detailed action-plans to prevent health issues. 
This addresses the problem in a practical manner where the astronaut has control over his/her health and has the tools to act accordingly, in order to reduce risk of mission abortion and compromising the astronauts health.
details:
The project works by using NASA Standards as parameters for an astronaut's health, and tracking these advanced metrics and comparing them to the standards in order to give an evaluation over the astronauts health, with the added benefit of being comprehensible and action-oriented, which intends to put the crew-members health in their own hands. We intend to reduce risks in spatial missions and improve the health of our crew. 

The elements that separate this project from others is the user-friendly interface, action-oriented mechanisms, real-life measurements as threshold and Dr. S.I.M.I. bot's assistance. Finally, this project was carefully designed by considering a variety of health statistics as well as external metrics and situations that might and will influence the well-being of the tribulation, using official standards and measurements as guidelines.
